title: Love Songs
content:
The Beatles’ albums in order – complete list! » Love Songs

Recorded: 1962-1970
Producers: George Martin, Phil Spector

Released: 21 October 1977 (US), 19 November 1977 (UK)

Contents

Paul McCartney: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar, piano, electric piano, maracas, cymbal

The Beatles compilation album Love Songs was released in October 1977.

The 25-song double album was predominantly written by Lennon–McCartney. ‘I Need You’ and ‘Something’ were by George Harrison, while the Buddy Holly song ‘Words Of Love’ was the only cover version.

The album came with a booklet featuring the songs’ lyrics printed on parchment-style paper. Early pressings came with a simulated leather cover.

The audio had the left and right channels reversed, apart from ‘Yes It Is’, ‘This Boy’, ‘PS I Love You’, which were fake stereo mixes.

Capitol Records planned to issue a single to promote the album. ‘Girl’ was to have been the lead song, with ‘You’re Going To Lose That Girl’ on the b-side, but the release was cancelled in October 1977.
